page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is a high-capacity server instance within the c4d family, featuring 192 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 744.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU.

This instance features integrated local storage consisting of 16 NVMe SSDs with a total capacity of 6442 GB. It does not include any GPU accelerators, making it a CPU-centric platform. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

The high density of dedicated vCPUs combined with substantial local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance suitable for IOPS-intensive workloads. It offers qualitative resource efficiency for large-scale databases, high-performance computing tasks, and data-intensive processing pipelines that require rapid local read and write operations.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is a high-capacity, CPU-centric server instance designed for resource-intensive workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 744.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is its integrated local storage array, which provides 6442 GB of capacity across 16 NVMe SSDs, delivering high-throughput and low-latency local data access. The instance does not include GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile is optimized for large-scale databases, data-intensive processing, and high-performance computing tasks that require substantial parallel processing power and fast local storage.
